name: Kingdoms and Castles Multiplayer (Beta)
description:
Steam-based multiplayer for Kingdoms and Castles. BETA / work in progress.

Host or join through a Steam lobby. Every player builds and runs their own kingdom on a shared map.

What works:
- Steam lobby host and join, with chat in the lobby and in game
- Shared map, with synced terrain, weather and trees
- Buildings: placement, construction, completion, demolition and keeps
- Villagers: spawns, deaths, and which house they live in
- Troops and combat: armies, ships, siege catapults, dragons and wolves. Every fight is resolved by one machine and the result is sent to the others, so both sides agree on what happened
- Fire and destruction
- Viking raids, wolf dens and witch huts, shared across every player
- Set what your kingdom charges for its exports, and sell to other players at your own prices
- Diplomacy: alliances, war and peace, demands and gifts, all answered in a popup and remembered across save and load
- Cross-player merchant trade
- Save and load a multiplayer session, and join a game already in progress

Known limits: army positions are not streamed, so a long chase can look different on each screen; a big save takes about a minute to send to each joining player.

Version 0.14.0 brings in a large set of fixes and features from Bill Kerman's community patch (save loading for guests, treasuries, harvests, save transfer, dragons, export prices and diplomacy popups). Thank you, Bill.

Report bugs with your Player.log (see the Workshop page) or on GitHub. Source and contributions: github.com/BrassyCrane/kingdoms-and-castles-multiplayer

Based on the KCM multiplayer mod, continued with the original author's permission. Thanks to them.
author: BrassyCrane
